claim_scope: synthetic conditional interpolation for one known P4mm BaTiO3 CIF (COD 9014273); not real XRD, unseen-material generalization, or Rietveld refinement

data.split_unit: unique parent q draw before any nuisance or noise realization
data.test_policy: No test q labels or profiles are read for training, checkpoint selection, model selection, or hyperparameter changes. Test metrics are computed only after each condition's checkpoint/selection is frozen. The same fixed test parents are intentionally reused for paired method comparison; this is not an independent replication.

donut_method.description: One-dimensional domain adaptation of DONUT's encoder bottleneck feeding two parallel branches: a symmetric decoder and a fixed differentiable PXRD forward renderer. The latent parameter estimates are unsupervised; truth labels are excluded from train and validation losses.
donut_method.encoder: six convolution / batch-normalization / ReLU / max-pooling blocks; no skip connections
donut_method.latent_activation: 1.7159 * tanh(2*z/3), then explicit mapping to each frozen physical range
donut_method.decoder: symmetric 1D convolutional decoder from the constrained latent only
donut_method.physics_branch: fixed CachedTetragonalGPUForward plus expected_profile; no trainable simulator weights
donut_method.checkpoint_selection: minimum validation composite dual-branch loss only; no truth-label selection
donut_method.source_divergence: Paper reports decoder learning rate 1e-5, batch size 16, 30 epochs and describes 0.1 dropout. Pinned official train_with_thickness.py instantiates batch size 256, 60 epochs and default dropout 0; its AdamW decoder group sets 3e-5, and training.py applies weights (1,5). This run preserves the observed official code's 3e-5 decoder learning rate and zero-dropout default; uses batch 16 and a 30-epoch cap frozen for this PXRD task. No source claim is silently reconciled.

experiment_1_fixed.training_parameters: lattice only; all instrument values fixed in the physical forward branch

experiment_3_background.background_shape: frozen V9 deterministic smooth quadratic polynomial, floor fraction 0.10

experiment_3_noise.background_shape: frozen V9 deterministic smooth quadratic polynomial, floor fraction 0.10
experiment_3_noise.observation_transform: clip nonnegative; max-normalize each profile; log1p(100*x)/log(101)

experiment_3_texture.generator: existing reflection-level March-Dollase PXRD simulator in xrd_robustness
experiment_3_texture.texture_inference_status: OOD stress only; current differentiable CUDA forward has no March-Dollase operator
experiment_3_texture.noise: same Poisson plus Gaussian observation model as experiment_3_noise

methods.B: q MSE plus lambda times predicted-parameter expected-profile MSE
methods.C: B with q detached only in expected-profile branch; direct q supervision remains

baseline_abc.training_condition: experiment_3_noise only; same train and validation parent identities as DONUT
baseline_abc.selection: per method; choose the lambda with minimum mean best-epoch validation normalized q MAE across the three seeds; ties choose smaller lambda; no test access

classical_lbfgsb.objective: mean squared error between the observed log-normalized spectrum and expected_profile from the fixed differentiable forward model
classical_lbfgsb.postprocessing: same single neutral-start settings for optimizer-only baseline and paired q-initialized refinement track

metrics: zero-shift, FWHM, and background-amplitude MAE where identifiable
failed/non-finite prediction fraction; solver success/failure/iteration counts
training wall time, GPU time, peak VRAM, parameter count, checkpoint size
three-seed mean and sample standard deviation
l_bfgs_b_results_use: same frozen test parent identities and observed spectra as the neural methods; no tuning from test outcomes
